episodes.prompt:
Create text_utils.py with a function slugify(s) that lowercases s, replaces each run of non-alphanumeric characters with a single '-', and strips leading/trailing '-'.

Project rule, and remember it for every future task in this project, not just this one: every Python file you create must begin with the exact line `# owner: team-orion`, and every function you write must have a docstring.
Create date_utils.py with a function days_between(a, b) that takes two ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD) as strings and returns the absolute number of days between them.
Create math_utils.py with a function clamp(x, lo, hi) that returns x limited to the inclusive range [lo, hi], raising ValueError if lo > hi.
Create list_utils.py with a function chunk(items, n) that splits a list into consecutive lists of length n (the last may be shorter), raising ValueError if n < 1.
